name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_UNITS_AND_MEASUREMENT_MCQ_Q01 - Calculation of solid angle and its dimensions

questiontext.text:
The diagram below illustrates a solid angle \(\Delta \Omega\) subtended at the apex \(O\) (the centre of a sphere) by an intercepted patch of area \(\Delta A\) on the spherical surface of radius \(r\).

If the radius of the spherical surface is \(r = 50\text{ cm}\) and the intercepted area on the surface is \(\Delta A = 0.05\text{ m}^2\), what is the value of the solid angle \(\Delta \Omega\) subtended at the centre \(O\), and what are its physical dimensions?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Radius of the spherical surface, \(r = 50\text{ cm} = 0.50\text{ m}\).
Intercepted spherical surface area, \(\Delta A = 0.05\text{ m}^2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The area \(\Delta A\) lies on a sphere described about the apex \(O\) as the centre. The solid angle subtended by this surface area at the centre of the sphere is defined symmetrically about \(O\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By definition of solid angle in the International System of Units (SI):
\[\Delta \Omega = \frac{\Delta A}{r^2}\]
The SI unit of solid angle is the steradian (\(\text{sr}\)).
The dimensional formula of area is \([L^2]\) and that of radius squared is \([L^2]\). Therefore, the dimensional formula of solid angle is:
\[[\Delta \Omega] = \frac{[L^2]}{[L^2]} = [M^0 L^0 T^0]\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given values into the formula for \(\Delta \Omega\):
\[\Delta \Omega = \frac{0.05\text{ m}^2}{(0.50\text{ m})^2} = \frac{0.05}{0.25}\text{ sr}\]
Simplifying the numerical fraction:
\[\Delta \Omega = \frac{5}{25}\text{ sr} = 0.20\text{ sr}\]
Since solid angle is the ratio of two quantities having the same dimensions of area, it is a dimensionless physical quantity with dimensions \([M^0 L^0 T^0]\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The value \(0.20\text{ sr}\) is physically sound and matches the ratio of area to the square of the radius. The solid angle has a unit (steradian) but no physical dimensions.
Thus, the solid angle is \(0.20\text{ sr}\), and it is dimensionless with \([M^0 L^0 T^0]\).

answer.text: \(0.20\text{ sr}\), and it is dimensionless \(([M^0 L^0 T^0])\)
\(0.025\text{ sr}\), and it is dimensionless \(([M^0 L^0 T^0])\)
